global: Educational resource. AgeLens is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and does not estimate any individual's biological age.
pending_review: Scientific records in this build are pending expert review. Each record carries its own sources, evidence level and stated uncertainty.
not_medical_advice: Nothing here recommends, prescribes, or endorses any drug, supplement, dose, or procedure. Research approaches are described to explain what is being studied, not to suggest you try them.
simulation: SIMULATION — NOT A CLINICAL PREDICTION. This traces directions through a curated map of relationships. It does not predict what would happen to any person.
stylization: Stylized schematic — shapes are simplified and not anatomically accurate. Positions are indicative only, and this view should not be used as an anatomy reference.
systemic_caveat: Improving one biological dimension does not establish whole-organism rejuvenation. Dimensions interact, benefits in one system can carry costs in another, and durability over a human lifespan is not demonstrated for any approach listed here.
